_about: The game's version, shown in the menu and in problem reports, and the 'What's new' list (newest first). Four numbers, Major.Minor.Patch.Build: Major = overhaul, Minor = feature batch, Patch = tweak or fix, Build = republish. Bump the version when a release changes what players see.

lines: Your ground is furnished: two dugouts and the players' tunnel in front of the main stand, corner flags, a gate with turnstiles on each side of the plaza, flagpoles and gates in your club's colours, trees in planters, and the team coaches parked by the main stand.
A horizon: fields and woods beyond the town's streets, the towers of the city centre in the distance (lit at night), a ring of hazy hills, and a few clouds.

A town round your ground: streets of terraced and detached houses, shops facing the stadium, blocks of flats, a church, a works with its chimney, parks, and match-day car parks. Windows and street lamps light up at night. You see it on the Stadium tab, the title screen and behind the stands in the 3D match.

New-look players in the 3D match: a proper shirt with a collar and cuffs, shorts that hang, turned-over socks, boots, and gloves and long sleeves for the keepers, in place of colours painted onto a bare body.
Season Ticket has its own address: https://seasonticket.longlight.games/. Report a problem now opens the contact form on longlight.games.
Behind the scenes: the game now runs from any web address, ready for its own domain later. Nothing changes in play, and saves are untouched.
Settings on the title screen: graphics, sound and tips, with or without a career.
The in-career menu is split into Career and Settings, so it is clear which choices belong to your club and which to this device.
A loading screen: the game shows its name and a loading bar the moment the page opens, instead of a blank screen, and offers Reload if it cannot load.
Save backup file: keep your save code as a small file (on a phone, Save to Files), and load it back from the title screen with Load backup file.
The game asks your browser to keep its storage, and the save code screen says whether it will.
A quiet reminder to keep a backup if you have not made one in a while.
Season Ticket is out: the first public release, free to play in your browser.
Everything from the test builds is in: your club, its money and its ground, live matches in text, 2D and 3D, and a story that runs season to season.
Help, and a short tip the first time you open each screen.
Sound in the office, an office radio, and chants at the match.
Long careers are better balanced on every difficulty.
The game starts much faster.
If something breaks, your save is kept and you can tell us what happened.
Add it to your home screen to play full screen, even offline.
A new title screen with your ground at dusk, and a Credits screen.
A full launch check: fixes for tips, the season review on small screens, offline play and save codes.
Loading a save code asks first, and keeps your old career as a backup you can bring back.
